verdict.rationale: Quotas and instance limits are a fair question for a GPU rental marketplace, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows user-set spend controls (per-key USD budgets, per-pod spend caps), which are adjacent budgeting features, not documented platform quotas or instance limits. Nothing describes a defined process for raising limits.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can see documented quotas and instance limits and raise them through a defined process
